assertion_analysis.failure_condition: If _recall_at takes the order tail instead of its head, the analytic first/last recall cells differ and controls exits nonzero; the worker's controls-red.log records this mutation with EXIT=1.
A status outside the four, a missing row status, or a status for an unrelated id makes _coverage_failures report a defect; the worker's planted pending and missing-status logs show VERIFY_FAIL.
A serialized row whose reused flag differs from its status is rejected; a wrong source entry reused flag moves both representations together, so this assertion does not detect that regression.

A missing or non-enumerated status makes recomputed counts differ from recorded totals; because totals and statuses originate in _axis_coverage, the check guards corruption of the stored record rather than the provenance of an answer.

failure_delta_status: unavailable: source manifest has no baseline_suite or after_suite arms, and named gate logs have no EXIT receipts; zero cannot be inferred

findings.text: the sampled group indexes are converted to a set at line 666, so a group drawn twice appears only once in a replicate; the claimed copy-group bootstrap intervals in the table are intervals from distinct-group subsamples rather than bootstrap resamples and must be recomputed.

the source brief explicitly requires re-running the composite scorer with labels shuffled within each split and checking 25% recall against the random band; analytic first/last orders exercise _recall_at only, so a scorer that leaks labels into risk can pass both controls and the required gate is absent.

the manifest reports EXIT=0 for measure, controls, verify and render, but those logs do not end in EXIT= and do not start with a revision and command; line 25 also places two annotated paths in negative_control_log instead of the required bare path, so the gate receipts are not auditable as declared.

random_expected is the nominal fraction rather than the actual expected recall count/N after rounding; for golden C calibration, 10% reads 9 of 94 rows, making the exact expectation 9/94 = 0.0957 rather than the displayed 0.100.

the status-versus-reused assertion compares two fields derived from the same entry['reused'] value at lines 564 and 570, so changing that source classification moves both sides together and the check cannot independently prove frozen-answer provenance.
